answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond and earn attestations over time before it can transact: new identities start at an inlet with limited throughput, like a narrow gate, and only climb the knoll to full privileges after peers verify sustained useful work. A jade token stake is slashed on fraud, so an attacker spawning thousands of fake agents must lock capital per identity, pay ongoing compute and bond costs, and lose the stake when caught, making a Sybil flood far more expensive than the rewards it could steal.
